name: Jair
title: Judge in Israel
summary: Jair was a judge in Israel from Gilead who led the people for twenty-two years. He was known for his thirty sons, who rode on thirty donkey colts and owned thirty towns in Gilead.

keyEvents.title: Jair Becomes Judge of Israel
keyEvents.description: After Tola, Jair from Gilead arose as judge over Israel and led the people for twenty-two years.

keyEvents.title: His Thirty Sons and Their Towns
keyEvents.description: Jair had thirty sons who rode on thirty donkey colts, and they owned thirty towns in Gilead that were called Havvoth Jair.

keyEvents.title: The Death and Burial of Jair
keyEvents.description: When Jair died, he was buried in Kamon after having faithfully served Israel as judge.
